name: Racines du Cœur

Respect this exact visual domain: Botanique Mutante, Fer Forgé Art Nouveau & Serres de Cristal. Palette: {"bg":"#064e3b","primary":"#34d399","secondary":"#e11d48","glow":"#fbbf24"}.
